message:
The other day, I found myself at my neighbor's house, rummaging through her go-bag. I always thought I was the ‘prepared’ one in the family, but there she was, with enough snacks and water to support a small army! As we giggled at the sheer amount of granola bars, I realized that being over-prepared can be a kind of comfort. 

It’s not about worrying over every little detail; it’s about creating a sense of ease when unexpected surprises come knocking. I think I might just take a page out of her book and add a few extra goodies to my own go-bag. After all, it’s always nice to be a little more ready than not, don’t you think?
